description: This file is a documentation in Markdown format detailing how to implement custom request classes and custom routes in FastAPI, including handling gzip compression, reading request bodies, and subclassing APIRoute and Request. It contains instructions, code snippets, and explanations aimed at advanced FastAPI users wishing to extend or modify request handling behavior.

classes.name: GzipRequest
classes.description: Custom subclass of Starlette's Request to handle automatic decompression of gzip-encoded request bodies.

classes.name: GzipRoute
classes.description: Custom subclass of FastAPI's APIRoute that uses GzipRequest to process request bodies, enabling handling of compressed requests seamlessly.

methods.name: GzipRequest.body
methods.description: Overridden method to decompress gzip bodies if the Content-Encoding header is set.

methods.name: GzipRoute.get_route_handler
methods.description: Overrides the route handler to replace the Request with a GzipRequest instance.
